info.name: File Share API - Multi-Country File Management
info.description: Complete API collection for File Share API - Upload, list, and download files organized by country

request.description: Verify the API server is running and healthy

formdata.description: Country classification (required) - e.g., Zambia, South Sudan, Kenya, Uganda

request.description:
Upload a new file with country classification.

Required fields:
- file: The file to upload
- country: Country name

Returns: fileId, originalName, fileSize, mimeType, country, uploadedDate

Retrieve all uploaded files with their metadata

Returns: Array of file objects with fileId, originalName, fileSize, mimeType, uploadedBy, country, uploadedDate, status

query.description: Country filter - returns only files for this country

request.description:
Retrieve files filtered by country

Query Parameters:
- country: Country name to filter by (e.g., Zambia, South Sudan)

Returns: Array of files matching the country filter

Get metadata for a specific file by fileId

Path Parameters:
- FILE_ID: The unique file identifier (from upload response or file list)

Returns: File metadata including fileId, originalName, fileSize, mimeType, uploadedBy, country, uploadedDate, status

Download a file by its fileId

Path Parameters:
- FILE_ID: The unique file identifier (from upload response or file list)

Usage:
1. Get the fileId from "List Files" or "List Files by Country" endpoint
2. Set FILE_ID variable in Postman
3. Send this request
4. File will be downloaded or metadata returned

Returns: File content (binary) or file metadata with download URL

variable.description: Base URL for the File Share API (Production)
Local development URL (use for local testing)
File ID - Get this from the upload response or file list response
